families.note: Track B act 6, executed under the frozen preregistration BARANDES-TUPLE-INSTANTIATION-PREREGISTRATION.md (blob 2a2216b7791e93303598dafb0d035db18ad9d88a, merged by PR #570), from main at ef441c3. The module carries TWO logically independent layers with orthogonal outcome grids, and the round reports a PAIR of labels rather than one headline: (TI1, UB2). LAYER 1 is the tuple instantiation. BarandesTuple types the external stochastic-process tuple (C, T, T0, Gamma, p, A) of Source C v2 eq (24) p. 8 with its TEN axioms X1a-X10, eqs (25)-(35) and (40)-(41), each as its own field with its own citation; the conditioning-time argument is kept in Gamma's type deliberately, since instantiating it at a singleton T0 is a declaration whereas erasing it would give a weaker tuple than the source defines. TI1 is PROVED: barandesTupleOfPPer constructs the tuple from PPer Gamma together with an arbitrary normalized p0, under the frozen declarations C = V, T = the naturals, T0 = {0}, Gamma_B(t from 0) = the TRANSPOSE of Gamma t, p CONSTRUCTED, and A the maximal algebra of maps from V times T to the reals. Every axiom is its own named result and the instantiation only assembles them, the four carried by the DECLARATIONS included -- X1a, X1b, X1c and X10 are stated about the constructed tuple as decl_carrier_finite, decl_init_eq_zero, decl_T0_singleton_containing_init and decl_alg_maximal, since a component supplied by rfl is still a component that has to be checked against what the source asks for; decl_T0_singleton_containing_init pins that T0 is the singleton {0} EXACTLY, which is the declaration X9's discharge runs at, and decl_alg_maximal states the operative half, that every map from V times T to the reals is a member. The class and not one realization is the target because Arc B's C_OI(V) = PPer(V) makes PPer the exact OI visible class; rootedRealization_instantiates is the corollary through the merged rootedMap_mem_PPer, and is a theorem rather than a definition so that the round introduces exactly the seven top-level definitions the freeze fixes. p is CONSTRUCTED and not declared because eq (33) p. 10 fixes p at every later time from p(0) and Gamma, leaving only p(0) free by eq (32): tupleP builds the whole time-dependent distribution from p0, X7 is tupleP_marg, X6 is tupleP_init_sum, and X8 is DERIVED from X3 and X6 exactly as the source derives eq (34) from (28) and (32). A freely declared normalized vector at every time would not have satisfied the component, which is why the first draft of the freeze was corrected. Act 1's Q8 established that our datum does not carry p, and that is unchanged: p0 is parameterized, never supplied. The T0 = {0} vacuity is reported in TWO parts and not blurred. X9 (eq (35) p. 10) is a REQUIRED axiom, since the source writes that Gamma will be assumed to satisfy it, but it is quantified over conditioning times only, never over general target times, which is how it coexists with act 1's BD3 and with the source's own p. 11 remark that the process is therefore indivisible for generic target times. It is DISCHARGED at T0 = {0} by trivialization (singletonDivisible_of_pper) as one of the ten. Separately, singletonDivisible_independent_of_pdivisible proves that discharging it bears on our all-time PDivisible in NEITHER direction, exhibiting two PPer families that both satisfy the singleton condition, one P-divisible and one not. So no reader can take TI1 as evidence that the OI family is divisible. LAYER 2 is the Source-A branch test, and it is a BRANCH TEST rather than a candidate selection: nothing here chooses a unitary lift or adjudicates act 5's gauge question. IsUnistochastic is Source A eq (30) p. 11 defined FROM SCRATCH, the existence of a complex unitary whose entrywise norm-squares are the matrix. It is deliberately NOT routed through QfbData, QStar, born, overlap_row_sum or overlap_col_sum: defining it that way would build into the predicate the very representation shortcut Arc D's RD1 disqualifies, and no theorem here discharges the branch test from the existence of any representation, since overlap_row_sum and overlap_col_sum are about the coherent-lift transport matrix on the shell, QfbData.born lives on the basis carrier, and no merged theorem identifies either with the transpose of Gamma t. unistochastic_isRowStochastic_and_isColStochastic is Source A's own p. 11 observation, proved here rather than cited, and it is what makes the branch decidable by a stochasticity check instead of by reasoning about all unitaries. UB2 is the verdict: offDirectBranch exhibits a lawful PPer family off the direct unistochastic branch, and not_directBranch records the universal statement's failure separately rather than leaving it implicit. offDirectBranch_realization is declared an ADDITION beyond those two: it takes the freeze's own named route through the merged pper_has_responseRealization to upgrade the same witness to the realization layer, so it cannot be read as an abstract matrix family with no OI realization behind it, and lawfulness of the prior is carried by RootedRealization's own prior_nonneg and prior_sum fields rather than by an added hypothesis. Both levels run through one extracted computation, collapsed_slice_not_unistochastic, rather than two. The witness is on Fin 2, with Gamma 0 the identity, period 2, and the row-stochastic slice sending every row to the first basis vector at odd times. Its transpose has COLUMNS summing to one, so it IS column-stochastic; the refutation therefore runs through the ROW half of the structural lemma applied to the transpose, not the column half, because transposing a row-stochastic matrix makes it column-stochastic and the failure that survives transposition into Source A's orientation is the row one. The orientation is stated this way because the opposite reading was written into an earlier draft of the freeze and corrected in review. WHAT THIS LICENSES: the OI visible class satisfies the external tuple's stated axioms at the frozen declarations, so the instantiation obligation act 3 named as a separate task is discharged at Layer 1's scope. WHAT IT DOES NOT: no result here says the external correspondence fails. Direct unistochasticity and DILATABILITY are different propositions and nothing here relates them in either direction -- a visible matrix that is not unistochastic may still embed in a larger unitary construction by Source A section 3.4 p. 10, and conversely a dilation would not show the original matrix unistochastic. Whether the dilation choice moves the induced candidate is not adjudicated here and belongs to a later round with its own freeze. No unitary lift is chosen, the gauge/empirical tension of act 5 is not adjudicated, no interference statement is proved, F1 versus F2 is not decided, acts 4 and 5 are not reopened, and no manuscript is edited. CE1 is EXISTENTIAL -- one witness, one extension -- and is never restated as a classification of the OI class, the same discipline UB2 carries. LAYER 0, TRACK I. CE3 IS NOT TRIGGERED: the extension relation is definable from the existing discrete OI family together with an explicitly chosen ambient time domain and embedding, without adding a new physical or dynamical principle -- OI supplies the finite carrier and the naturals-indexed row-stochastic family, while NNReal and the unit-step embedding are layer-0 choices recorded as choices. E0 is answered positively and cheaply as predicted in advance, and is labelled a SCREENING RESULT wherever it appears, never CE1; isRowStochastic_convex proves the freeze's convexity observation rather than citing it. LAYER 1, TRACK B: Source A's contract transcribed with coordinates BEFORE any construction, from the authoritative PDF surface whose page 1 stamp reads arXiv:2302.10778v3, the arXiv HTML rendering being non-admissible. The D5a/D5b conclusions and the DC1 exhibitions stand on their own statements and proofs; the procedural certification does not.
